author: agent
objective: Association of 2018 annual PM10 daily-limit exceedance days with cumulative COVID-19 infections among Italian provincial-capital cities, adjusted for 2019 population density.

scientific_invariants.research_question: Association of 2018 annual PM10 daily-limit exceedance days with cumulative COVID-19 infections among Italian provincial-capital cities, adjusted for 2019 population density.
scientific_invariants.target_outcome_and_population: Cumulative confirmed COVID-19 infections among residents of randomly selected Italian provincial-capital cities (N=55), separately at 17 March, 7 April, and 27 April 2020.
scientific_invariants.principal_contrast: Outcome ratio for a doubling of annual 2018 PM10 daily-limit exceedance days, exp(beta*ln(2)) from log-log OLS.
principal_variants: Adjusted log-log OLS for infections at 17 March, 7 April, and 27 April 2020, each with log 2019 population density.
scientific_invariants.broad_geography: Italian provincial-capital cities; article reports random selection of 55.

article_evidence.finding: Data/design and Table 6 specify N=55 provincial capitals, 2018 PM10/ozone exceedance days, March/April 2020 infection outcomes, 2019 density, and log-log OLS.
Task primary construct is PM10 >50 µg/m³ annual exceedance count and doubling contrast.

article_evidence_map.ambiguity: Article's methods largely say PM10 or ozone, whereas Table 6 says PM10. Primary analysis follows task PM10 construct; combined measure is sensitivity if recoverable.
